message.content: {"key_mechanism_gt": "An Ag(I)-catalyzed [3 + 2] cycloaddition between a chiral Ni(II) dehydroalanine complex and α-imino esters produces enantioselectively congested pyrrolidine complexes with three defined carbon stereocenters, including two quaternary centers.", "key_mechanism_gen": "The chiral silver center acts as a template that locks the conformation of the dehydroalanine nucleophile and directs the approach of the α-imino ester electrophile, thereby sterically blocking one face of the π-system to ensure asymmetric induction during the cycloaddition step.", "recovery": "PARTIAL", "rationale": "The generated hypothesis omits the Ni(II) complex and focuses on silver templating, which is a different mechanistic detail."}
